notes: The parts list marks the SCP1000 breakout as not in the catalogue, but the catalogue does have scp1000-breakout, so I used it and added no new part types.
The schematic crosses the two lines: D7 goes to CSB and D6 goes to DRDY. This matches the code (chipSelectPin=7, dataReadyPin=6).
SPI pins: D13 to SCK, D12 to MISO, D11 to MOSI.
The sensor runs from 3.3V, not 5V. The red wire goes to the Arduino 3.3V pin on the power header.
The black wire goes to a GND pin on the power header. I picked GND.2, but any Arduino GND pin would work.
The breadboard view shows no breadboard, so the sensor is wired straight to the Arduino with male-to-male jumper wires.
Wire colours follow the breadboard image: blue for signals, red for 3.3V, black for GND.
